The harmonic/golden/Euler triangle supplies meaningful source observables, but matching snapshots does not by itself determine the internal arrows or the selected arithmetic boundary. This research round proves new all-scale composition inequalities, identifies a sharp role for the golden mark, and constructs exact countermodels and reconstruction theorems.

Child of **#405 at `6cf5050ff2cfd92e7a0c8876da5233be6ff117f5`**. Head **`7b5a2b4534aa5e71865046ca8d3f723d8002b9fe`**. All **139 files / 13,068 insertions** are additive under `research/2026-10-30/triangle_fabric/`; much of the volume is raw exact receipts. The original four signed BBP poles, zero boundary, historical contracts, author provenance and workflows are unchanged. Siblings #404/#406 were read at pinned heads, not merged.

**Strongest mathematical results**

1. **All-rank harmonic composition inequality.** For every real a>0, integer k>=2, and independent draws X_i from the authentic positive source law, with S_k=sum X_i,
   `E log S_k − E log X_1 − (H_(2k−1)−1) >= (1379/900)(k−1)/(2k+1) a^4/(a+5)^6 >0.`
   This bound is asymptotically sharp for each fixed k. A distinct conditional-Beta argument gives sharper two-copy bounds and the exact first non-product source jet.
2. **Golden is load-bearing in a precise comparison.** For the declared Laplace composition correction, lambda=phi^(-1) is the **sharp minimum mark** giving positivity for every real a>0 and every integer k>=2. At each rank the threshold is the unique root of `sum_(j=k−1)^(2k−2)t^j=1`. Necessity uses the continuous extension a→0; no discrete-clock sharpness is claimed. The corresponding finite-source Oily rank arrow has an explicit positive correction. Euler's common constant fixes the absolute log anchor but cancels from normalized relative arrows.
3. **Snapshots versus internal arrows.** An exact positive sensor preserves every one-time full-posterior snapshot at every horizon while changing history-conditioned transitions. Under native grade support, d-step coarsening has exactly m(d−1) invisible coupling dimensions; consecutive pairwise marginals determine the one-step arrow. Distinct positive arrows can even match the entire two-time matrix of {1,H_j,lambda^j}. A complete finite Cauchy/resolvent family reconstructs the arrow, with explicit conditioning cost.
4. **Exact arithmetic quotient.** For every rational polynomial shift filter F, the selected boundary is `alpha_F=F(16)pi+b_F`, b_F rational. Rational decaying coboundaries correspond exactly to F(16)=0. Nonzero F(16) preserves equivalence to the unresolved pi-normality question.
5. **Stronger zero-boundary controls.** Positive sources can match any prescribed authentic forcing prefix and finite kernel jets, yet have an exactly dyadic boundary, all fixed-frequency character means tending to1, and summable lag energy. Minimal filter degree is N+M. The complementary construction preserves pi exactly while changing internal source arrows and matching arbitrary prefixes/jets; its signed sums differ by O_h(1).

The source composition uses declared independent draws, **not independent BBP digits**. These source-only inequalities survive the coherent changed seed. The new source controls are explicitly different from the authentic four-pole source. The earlier October25 finite-moment/jet counterfeit mechanism and classical Beta/Gamma/orthogonal-polynomial inputs are credited; no scholarly priority is claimed.

- New focused tests: **43 PASS**.

- **391 inherited manifest files unchanged**, 17 pinned ancestry edges verified.
- Final artifact audit before and after commit: **136 hashed artifacts, 82 nested artifact hashes, 29 pinned source inputs, 31 command-output hashes**, PASS.
- Mathematics catalog check fails identically on untouched exact parent405; both raw failures retained.
- Shared-model mathematical reviews are not independent external referees. No new Lean certification is claimed.

**No new authentic positive-density fixed-frequency bound was proved.** The source-selected signed interaction remains explicit in the [open obligation](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/7b5a2b4534aa5e71865046ca8d3f723d8002b9fe/research/2026-10-30/triangle_fabric/SELECTED_OBLIGATION.md). This characterizes declared mathematical families, not a universal physical carrier. **Pi normality, SC-06 and RH remain OPEN.**

Late delivery discovery: sibling [#407](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/pull/407), head `5f05181339ea97a56999ca8b8ab10a2009c6c84d`, describes actual selected cylinder/Walsh collision statistics. Its PR metadata was inspected after this commit; its proofs were not audited or integrated here, and it is not a premise of these results. It is a useful next comparison with the explicitly auxiliary arrows in this draft.

## Operation Arithmetic Cylinder Tiling — selected two-time collision and Walsh refinement

**DRAFT RESEARCH ONLY.** Exact parent PR #405 at `6cf5050ff2cfd92e7a0c8876da5233be6ff117f5`, rooted in Main XVI; two additive commits, current head `5f05181339ea97a56999ca8b8ab10a2009c6c84d`. Nine new files confined to `research/2026-10-30/cylinder_tiling_collision/`. Original four signed BBP poles, `U_0=0`, historical theorem contracts, production code, workflows and `main` unchanged.

### Actual mathematical results

- **CTC-01:** Exact source-conjugate base-16 cylinder tiling: `C_(n+1)∘F_(n+1)=D_16∘C_n`, with `C_n(x)={x+T_n}`. Every selected actual digit word is a transported cylinder, certified by rational BBP states and positive Green-tail intervals.
- **CTC-02:** Exact nonnegative refinement defect `Q_(m+1)-Q_m=16^(m+1) Σ_(v,a)(p(va)-p(v)/16)^2=16^m Σ_(v,nontrivial 4-bit Walsh χ)|Σ_a χ(a)p(va)|²`. This is an **actual selected two-time collision** statistic, not the auxiliary Gamma/Pascal source posterior.
- **CTC-03 (CLASSICAL entropy principle, self-contained proof):** Subexponential collision excess in refinement depth, `limsup_m (1/m)limsup_N log Q_(m,N)=0`, characterizes base-16 normality by the Rényi-2/Shannon inequality, shift invariance and maximal entropy. **No original-source bound establishing its premise is supplied.**
- **CTC-04:** Exact Haar expectation `E Q_(m,N)=1+(16^m-1)/N`, valid even for overlapping word windows; periodic order-two de Bruijn passes depth 1/2 perfectly but fails at depth 3; coherent same-forcing seed and biased model fail.
- **CTC-05:** A real source-specific smoothed two-time transport inequality. For tent kernel at cell size `16^-m`, `|E_pure-E_BBP_rational| <= 2 B 16^(2m)/N < 16^(2m)/(16N)`, where `B=Σ_n T_n=(Σ_n r(n)-π)/15<1/32`. This is **representation transport**, not a signed saving.
- **CTC-05b:** Exact hard/soft domination: `Q_(m,N) <= (256/15) Kcal_(16^(-(m-1)),N)` for m>=2. Thus any authentic source-derived subexponential bound on the smoothed rational-orbit pair energy transfers to hard cylinders and proves normality. **The source-derived bound is still OPEN.**
- **CTC-06:** First 256 selected hexadecimal positions certified using only exact four-pole rational recurrence and bounded Green tail; collision energies `Q_1=2117/2048`, `Q_2=31/16`, `Q_3=17`. These are **finite observations only**.
- **CTC-07:** Exact de Bruijn graph flow/current conservation; periodic adversaries show conservation alone is insufficient.

### Execution and authority

- **18/18** locally executed Python stdlib Fraction tests PASS; syntax compile PASS; raw test log committed.
- **9/9** exact remote Git blob SHA1 values match the locally executed/tested sources (plus SHA256 manifest for non-manifest files).
- **NOT RUN/CLAIMED:** full SUCC 10,008-test root suite, hosted exact-head CI, Lean formalization of these theorems, external blind review.
- No π-normality, RH, SC-06 or source-selected collision-exponent theorem is claimed. Positive source Gamma fields and selected digit probabilities remain distinct.

Read [THEOREMS.md](research/2026-10-30/cylinder_tiling_collision/THEOREMS.md), [CLAIMS.md](research/2026-10-30/cylinder_tiling_collision/CLAIMS.md), [NEXT.md](research/2026-10-30/cylinder_tiling_collision/NEXT.md), and [VALIDATION.md](research/2026-10-30/cylinder_tiling_collision/VALIDATION.md).

**Next decisive proof target:** derive from authentic `U_0=0` and original four poles a subexponential all-depth upper bound for the full context-resolved Walsh collision defect, using actual complementary CRT phases. Entropy criterion alone is not a proof. No merge authorized.

PR #403 proves logarithmic selected phase slips, but its fixed-frequency theorem does not establish positive-density dispersion. This draft extends the theorem uniformly over growing frequencies and lags, proves sharp hostile controls, and attacks the complete signed CRT weight through exact bounded-slip cylinders.

Child of **#403 at `5f350af7808532e55d74e80c948c02bb385c6e70`**. Head **`6cf5050ff2cfd92e7a0c8876da5233be6ff117f5`**. All 134 files are additive under `research/2026-10-30/zero_boundary_dispersion/`; most volume is raw exact receipts. Original four signed poles, zero boundary, historical contracts, workflows and main are unchanged.

**Strongest results**

- **Selected uniform extension:** one threshold works for every `ell<=A/26`, `|h|ell<=A³/6`, giving a definite lag slip in `[A,8A)`. In particular, with `eta=1-cos(pi/10)`,
  `N-|S_N(h,0)| >= eta/(4 log8) log⁺(N/|h|^(1/3))-C`,
  with one C independent of N,h. The published Zeilberger–Zudilin theorem is the only irrationality input for π. Fixed-h growth remains logarithmic.
- **Sharp Diophantine barrier:** explicit original-forcing changed seeds have Θ(log N) signed loss despite exact finite irrationality exponent. Shallit's classical sparse example even has bounded partial quotients and exponent 2. Thus a better irrationality exponent alone cannot force positive density. A rational periodic translation gives positive-density lag-one energy while remaining nonnormal.
- **Actual fractional signed bound in a declared moving-frequency band:** for every real seed and `512A²/15<=|h|<=A³`,
  `|sum_(n=A)^(2A)e(hU_n(s))| <= A+1-A/578`.
  For A divisible by 4, a second bound reaches `A²/2<=|h|<=A²`. The coherent seed proves the quadratic/cubic scale obstructions. These are source-forcing bounds, not selected fixed-h normality results.
- **Arithmetic transport complexity:** the conductor rate 6 survives every moving integer filter of degree o(n), subexponential height, and P_n(16) nonzero. A p-cofiber root of odd order D belongs to the complete ordinary character-value field over F_(p^f) iff D divides p^f−1; minimum f is ord_D(p), at least (6n+o(n))/log p. This does not identify a particular Gauss sum with the cofiber.
- **Signed assembly and controls:** exact repunit-frequency source transport and a finite Gram inequality; all-frequency liminf mean energy>=1 suffices for normality, but any fixed smaller floor admits a nonnormal invariant mixture. Native three-mark variation has an effective tail bound. Full-Walsh noncommuting endpoint frames remain flat under their precise factorization hypothesis.

**Direct SC-06 attack**

48 fresh joint primary/cofiber/full rows (24 eligible) pass the declared finite half-slip test. Exact dyadic shadows suppress complete finite-window slips while preserving every odd-primary trajectory; they eventually become circle aliases, so no false rational-translation counterclaim is made. The exact positive-slip cylinder union was also executed on 12 fresh prefixes at p1153/1201, with 1,548 separate forward membership checks. Authentic coordinates are excluded; coherent coordinates remain inside. A uniform arithmetic exclusion on full periods with a positive slip fraction is still missing.

36 rigorous finite Gram certificates pass; 17 authentic finite examples refute a universal finite-window energy floor 1. Their asymptotic replacement remains open.

**Validation actually executed**

- Full native repository suite: **10,008 PASS**, 977.825s.
- New focused tests: **54 PASS**; 31 inherited focused tests PASS (12 from #403 and 19 adversarial transfer controls), plus the parent oracle.
- Provenance (72 items), foundations, ordinal and mathematics graph: PASS.
- 262 inherited manifest files unchanged; 14 ancestry edges verified.
- Standalone Lean 4.14 checks only the finite integer no-wrap lemma and iteration; reported axioms `propext`, `Quot.sound`. No analytic theorem is claimed Lean-certified.
- Separate rational/symbolic/integer-prefix/interval implementations and complementary shared-model reviews retained.
- Catalog check fails identically on the untouched exact #403 baseline; recorded as baseline failure.
- Initial Lean compiler and spectral serialization failures preserved with corrected runs.
- Final artifact validator: 129 hashed artifacts, 68 nested artifact hashes, 37 source-input hashes, 33 receipt-output hashes; PASS before and after commit.
